name: Sakai Touma
source:
Hobby: Watching Movies
Favorite Food: Omelette Rice

A well-mannered and elegant young man. He generally isn't overly enthusiastic, but his frank remarks always stand out. The female guests love his aloofness and his feminist side he would sometimes show.
